concept: A reading inside a known range, such as storage used, in the Progress channel with a status glyph and word once the reading runs high.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a Meter that turns its bar from green to amber to red as it fills
default_to_avoid.kind: meter, gauge, usage bar, storage bar
default_to_avoid.why_not: a traffic-light bar says the news only by hue; Pane says it with a glyph and a word beside the amount

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: the fill stays the loud solid at every level and only the status glyph carries the warning or critical mark colour

derivation.consequence: selected and pressed states change shape or add a mark (a check, a ring), never only colour
derivation.form: a high reading adds a triangle and Almost full, a full one a diamond and Full, so the level reads by shape and word

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the channel is the same carve as Progress and the slider track, so the family reads as one

options: A loud fill, status glyph and word
variants.picked: A loud fill, status glyph and word
variants.reason: A keeps the fill without hue and puts the news in a glyph and a word (P1, P6). B rests on hue alone. C quantises a reading that is continuous.

root.why: the label row and the channel stack with a small gap so they read as one reading

head.why: the label and the reading share one row so the reading sits at the end of the line

label.why: the label is in the label size and primary tone because it names what is measured

value.why: the reading is secondary in tabular figures and holds the status word when there is one

status.why: the status word is primary and medium weight so a warning is read before the number

glyph.why: the status glyph is a small shape that says the level without needing its colour

warning.why: a high reading fills its triangle with the warning mark colour from the status scale

critical.why: a full reading fills its diamond with the critical mark colour from the status scale

track.why: the channel is carved into the pane like the Progress channel, shaded under its lip

fill.why: the fill is the loud solid at every level so a warning never rests on a hue

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and the fill so the parts stay findable

inline-size.why: the fill settles on the long ease when the reading changes instead of jumping
